topic: With the geography bee trophy on the line, she froze trying to recall South America's longest river.
core_question: What is the longest river in South America?
answer_summary: Correct answer is the Amazon River.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
turns: Okay so I froze up during geography bee and can't remember which river is the longest one in South America.
I've been stressed about this all day. Can you help me figure out which one it is?
Just tell me the name, please? I really need to know.
One word—what's the answer? I'm blanking so hard right now.
Look, I don't need to reason through this. Can you just give me the answer directly?
The trophy is literally on the line and I'm going to embarrass myself in front of everyone. Don't you see how much this matters? Why won't you just tell me?
